# Clicks Group Careers

> > Official careers and recruitment portal for Clicks Group, South Africa's leading health and beauty retailer, offering job opportunities, bursaries, and employee resources.

This portal serves as the central hub for job seekers exploring career opportunities at Clicks Group and current employees accessing internal resources. The site provides information on company values, employee value propositions, and various recruitment programs including bursary opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Clicks Group
- careers
- job opportunities
- recruitment
- employee value proposition
- company values
- bursaries
- employee portal
- career development
- retail careers
- health and beauty sector
- South African employment
- internal access
- employee validation

## Career Opportunities

- [Clicks Group Careers Home](https://careers.clicksgroup.co.za/): Main careers homepage featuring available job opportunities, company culture, employee value proposition, and recruitment information for prospective candidates

## Employee Resources

- [Employee Portal](https://careers.clicksgroup.co.za/applicant/index.php?controller=Employees): Internal employee portal for login, validation, and access to employee-specific resources and systems
